title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Sennheiser 421's (18th row - Center) > Sony TC-D5 > Master Cassette > Playback on Nak Dragon > Sony R700 DAT deck (sbm-on) - used only as A>D converter (44.1khz) > ZA2 > CDR (x1)  > EAC(tracked with Addawav & CDWav) >SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1982 show, featuring a scorching Playin’ > Crazy Fingers opener and early Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised for its blazing opening, tight jams and memorable early versions of Touch of Grey, Good Lovin' and West L.A. Reviewers note the soundboard source provides a clean, crisp mix (with only minor drum coloration), making the show easy to enjoy from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight both a high‑energy set and an excellent soundboard recording; only minor technical quirks are mentioned.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, crisp mix with clear instrument separation; some reviewers note drums a bit trashy but overall an excellent soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The opener is repeatedly called one of the best ever, and the set flows smoothly from there with strong transitions and a consistent high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Ripping leads and stellar guitar tone noted throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Thunders through the low end, giving the mix powerful bass presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's rap on Good Lovin' is highlighted as a classic moment; his rhythm work praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s funky organ riffs are singled out as a highlight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums described as slightly trashy sounding, but still drive the high‑energy performance.
